text.room.gatehouse.title: Gatehouse
text.room.gatehouse.description: Arrow slits light a draughty stone gatehouse. An [oak door](oak_door) leads north to the courtyard; a squat iron-bound door stands to the east.
text.detail.oak_door: A heavy oak door, banded with iron and shut fast.
text.detail.oak_door.open: The heavy oak door stands open to the courtyard.
text.room.courtyard.title: Courtyard
text.room.courtyard.description: Weeds push up between the flagstones of a small walled courtyard.
text.room.cell.title: Cell
text.room.cell.description: A cramped cell. Old straw rots in one corner, and a chain hangs from the wall.
text.item.iron_key.room: An [iron key] lies among the weeds.
text.item.iron_key.description: A heavy iron key, its bow shaped like a ring.
text.narration.knock.actor: You rap on the oak door. The knocks echo in the courtyard beyond; no one answers.
